title: timonius rumphii
intro: Timonius rumphii, commonly known as the Rumph's timonius, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian folk medicine, where it is believed to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
